caption.description: Short caption from the owner or the page itself, never invented

chapter.description: Chapter hierarchy: domain > chapter > section > page

domain.description: Must match a categories.json id to appear in that domain's row

evidenceStatus.description: Whether the transcription/content has been checked against the original page

file.description: In-repo relative image path, e.g. notes/institutions-markets/p001.jpg

id.description: Stable page id, used by related[]

parentId.description: Id of the parent page/section, for nested hierarchies

related.description: Ids of related notes (cross-references, contradictions, follow-ups)

transcription.description: Full text transcribed from the handwritten page; searched, shown in the viewer, never presented as the original image

subject.description: Subject of the note, distinct from topic (topic is the finer tag)

sourceDate.description: Date of the original handwritten source, when known; null means unknown, never guessed

chapterId.description: Stable chapter id this note belongs to, e.g. ch-institutions-markets-01

originalImage.description: Reference to the untouched original page image, e.g. notes/<domain>/<id>.jpg; file is the display copy, originalImage is the source of truth

editorialEnhancements.description: Editorial work added on top of the original, each labelled, never presented as original text

reviewStatus.description: Current review status; publication{} records approval when it happens

relationships.description: Two separate relationship types, never merged into one generic list

chronology.description: Historical chronology: what came before/after, in time

conceptual.description: Conceptual dependency: what a concept depends on, requires, relates to, or contradicts

description: One entry per handwritten page. v1 fields still load; v2 fields are optional. Content organization (v3 fields, all optional except id/title/domain): subject, sourceDate (null = unknown), chapterId + chapter/section/parentId/order (chapter relationships), originalImage (untouched original), transcription, editorialEnhancements (labelled, never original), privacy (public|internal|private|restricted), reviewStatus (draft|in-review|approved|published), relationships split into chronology (precedes|follows|contemporary-with) and conceptual (depends-on|prerequisite-for|related-to|contradicts). related[] is kept for backward compatibility as a generic list; new notes should use relationships.* instead.
title: Systems Handbook notes.json v2
